articles.summary: We're Rivet, a new open-source, self-hostable serverless platform. We've been in the weeds with SQLite-on-the-server recently and – boy – do we have a lot of thoughts to share. Give us a star on GitHub, we'll be sharing a lot more about SQLite soon!
articles.title: SQLite-on-the-Server Is Misunderstood: Better At Hyper-Scale Than Micro-Scale
